title: Chapter 1399 - 14: The First Second Realm Method

Chapter 1399 - 14: The First Second Realm Method

Chapter 1399: Chapter 14: The First Second Realm Method

"Enter the Immortal Path?"

The numerous figures in front of the Bronze Immortal Palace were not surprised at all.

At the end of the Primeval Era, before the three Immortal Emperors led the Immortal Kings and Red Dust Immortals into the Immortal Path,

they deliberately left behind the Bronze Immortal Palace, not only to ensure the stability of the Great Wilderness Source World but also to guide future new Red Dust Immortals into the Immortal Path.

To completely connect the world at the end of the Immortal Path with the Great Wilderness Source World is as difficult as climbing to the heavens; with each additional Red Dust Immortal, the hope increases slightly.

Twenty thousand years ago, Lin Yuan easily cleared one Restricted Zone after another, showcasing the power of a supreme sovereign at the outset.

At that time, the numerous figures in the Bronze Immortal Palace were unsure if Lin Yuan had become a Red Dust Immortal.

However, eight thousand years ago, Lin Yuan came to them proactively and almost shattered the Bronze Immortal Palace.

It indisputably proved that he had already surpassed the Red Dust Immortals.

At that time, the numerous figures in the Bronze Immortal Palace asked Lin Yuan whether he was entering the Immortal Path.

The answer received was simply not in a hurry.

...

"The Immortal Path..."

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound as he looked into the depths of overlapping space-time.

Now that he had absorbed the Undying Matter to its limits, staying in the Great Wilderness Source World held little meaning.

Instead, he could explore the Immortal Path that attracted so many Red Dust Immortals, Immortal Kings, and even Immortal Emperors.

The value of the Immortal Path, which can attract so many temporal beings to follow its trail, surely extends far beyond turning the Great Wilderness Source World into an unprecedented holy land for cultivation.

For temporal beings themselves, it certainly has irreplaceable significance.

"Timelines involving the Immortal Path become obscure and twisted, difficult to observe."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, over the past twenty thousand years, he had attempted more than once to observe the timelines related to the Immortal Path.

The information he obtained wasn’t very comprehensive.

But even if it was just fragmentary information, it made Lin Yuan’s heart throb.

The world at the end of the Immortal Path is a great opportunity even for a Time Lord.

...

"Lord Tianyuan, the Bronze Immortal Palace is sealing the entrance connecting to the Immortal Path. To enter, one needs to break through with the power of a Red Dust Immortal level." The leading figure in front of the Bronze Immortal Palace said in a low voice.

This is also the prerequisite threshold for entering the Immortal Path.

If one is not a Red Dust Immortal, even finding the Bronze Immortal Palace and discovering the entrance to the Immortal Path would be in vain.

In fact, if one isn’t even a Red Dust Immortal, entering the Immortal Path wouldn’t significantly help in penetrating the world at its end.

"I know."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He had already grasped a good deal of information about entering the Immortal Path.

Before coming, he had also made many preparations in the Great Wilderness Source World, ensuring that the Human Race wouldn’t become the target of an alien siege in his absence.

Over twenty thousand years, under Lin Yuan’s deliberate cultivation and promotion,

while the Human Race hadn’t produced another Great Emperor, numerous special quasi-emperors comparable to a Great Emperor had emerged.

Moreover, Lin Yuan had already cleansed numerous alien races and Restricted Zones several times, leaving the Supreme Emperors who harbored resentment against the Human Race completely eradicated.

The status of the Human Race in the Great Wilderness Source World was unshakable; even if Lin Yuan entered the Immortal Path, there would be little change.

In simple terms, the current Human Race, even without Lin Yuan, could still overlook the Great Wilderness Source World.

"Hmm."

The numerous figures in front of the Bronze Immortal Palace all stepped aside in unison.

Rumbling!

The Bronze Immortal Palace began to tremble and slowly shifted in a different direction.

In the place where the Bronze Immortal Palace originally stood, a distorted void could vaguely be seen.

This is the entrance connecting to the Immortal Path.

In the Primeval Era, the three Immortal Emperors gazed into the past and future.

It was here that they discovered traces of the Immortal Path, the source of the Undying Matter in the cosmos.

Before this, even as powerful as an Immortal Emperor could attract Undying Matter, they couldn’t capture the source of Undying Matter.

Lin Yuan quietly watched the distorted void.

Then, he stretched out his hand.

And slapped forward.

The heavens roared, and the Great Path twisted.

This slap from Lin Yuan was casual, yet the power it unleashed was at the peak of Red Dust Immortals, approaching the strike of an Immortal King.

From the spot where Lin Yuan stood, space-time rapidly vanished, as if reopening Heaven and Earth.

...

Lin Yuan broke through the entrance to the Immortal Path without concealing it, and the terrifying power vibrated, quickly affecting the entire Great Wilderness Source World.

"Such power?"

In a hidden corner of the Great Wilderness Source World, a scruffy man abruptly looked up at the sky, "The Immortal Path, is this the aura of the Immortal Path being broken? Is another Red Dust Immortal entering the Immortal Path?"

The commotion of the Immortal Path being breached was felt more intensely by the stronger beings, especially those at the level of a Great Emperor who could perceive the Undying Matter and naturally detect the fluctuations at its source.

"Who is it? Is it that Emperor Tianyuan?"

The scruffy man couldn’t help but think, twenty thousand years ago, Emperor Tianyuan swept through that era, and he had once sensed a meager aura of this Great Emperor from afar.

He just hadn’t expected the other was a Red Dust Immortal?

"Red Dust Immortal, huh."

The scruffy man sighed in his heart; the years he had experienced were immeasurable, existing since the Primeval Era, yet he still hadn’t grasped the chance to break through to a Red Dust Immortal.

The biggest hurdle to becoming a Red Dust Immortal is breaking through the cycle of time.

The supreme beings absorb large amounts of Undying Matter, their lifespans extraordinarily lengthy, living one life after another, all preparing to break through the cycle of time.

...

"A Red Dust Immortal, has our Great Wilderness Source World birthed a Red Dust Immortal?"

"It’s Emperor Tianyuan, Emperor Tianyuan is breaking the Immortal Path."

One by one, the supremos of the Great Wilderness Source World vaguely felt something, and their hearts were greatly shocked.

The surviving supremos generally harbored no animosity towards the Human Race and had all met Lin Yuan, thus they immediately detected that it was Emperor Tianyuan who was breaking the Immortal Path.
